summary: Tested screenshot zip download only. GET /api/downloads/screenshots returns 200, content-type application/zip, content-disposition attachment; filename="dhairya-portfolio-screenshots.zip", 1,368,419 bytes, valid zip (testzip OK) with 47 .jpeg files under shots/{desktop_intro:9, desktop_light:11, desktop_dark:11, desktop_pages:6, mobile:10}. Browser: /downloads/index.html renders lavender pill link; clicking it fires a download event with suggested filename dhairya-portfolio-screenshots.zip and saved file is a valid zip with 47 jpegs. Direct navigation to /api/downloads/screenshots triggers download (valid zip). Legacy URL /downloads/dhairya-portfolio-screenshots.zip also triggers a valid zip download in Chromium headless.
critical_code_review_comments: download_screenshots uses FileResponse without existence check; if the zip is missing it raises a 500 instead of 404 (minor).
Zip is duplicated in backend/downloads and frontend/public/downloads (1.4 MB each) - fine, but keep in sync if regenerated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Download feature verified. Regression: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_downloads.py. Playwright: use page.expect_download; page.goto raises 'Download is starting' which is expected.
